description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Vault enters, Ultron triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Resolve the Ultron trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Mana Vault that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
During your next turn, activate the Mana Vault token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Mana Vault token.
Repeat from step 5.
